explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step and is non-zero only at D2, where it peaks at 8-10 when the agent chose a1 but a rare transition took it to S2 after a rewarded previous trial (it is about 5 if that trial was unrewarded, and 0-2 if the previous trial was also an a1-to-S2 rare). It reaches about 4-6 at D2 when an a2 choice reaches S2 commonly right after a switch from a1 or right after a trial where a2 led rarely to S1, sits at 0-1 for other a2-to-S2 common trials, and is 0 whenever S1 is reached.
